title: Build a vote on the school trip
instruction: You are adding a vote on the school trip to the class app. Put the parts in order so that each one comes only after what it depends on.
steps: The teacher enters the options: the mountains, the capital, the seaside
A pupil chooses an option and sends their vote
The app saves the vote and makes sure everyone votes only once
The app counts the votes for each option
The app shows where the class is going
debrief: Each part stands on the one before it. Without options there is nothing to vote for, and without saved votes there is nothing to count.
why: Without options there is nothing to vote for.
You can only vote once the options have been entered.
Only a vote that has arrived can be saved and checked.
Only saved votes can be counted.
You show the winner only when the votes have been added up.
